prompts.title: 브론즈 새틴
prompts.prompt: Create one premium ABSTRACT BACKGROUND IMAGE, no text, no symbols, no UI, no logos, no objects. Extremely wide horizontal banner composition intended as an elegant 1920x88 luxury website header. Art direction: flowing brushed bronze satin, fine anisotropic metal grain, two or three broad very shallow horizontal folds that drift from upper left to lower right; soft burnished champagne-gold reflections on deep warm charcoal. Refined, flat restrained lighting, no inflated 3D bevels, no dotted mesh, no glitter, no ornamental curls, no gaming or casino objects. Quiet negative space across the central horizontal band for readable UI. Broad lines remain visible when shown as a very shallow strip. Keep the brightest gold in the upper quarter, bottom fades smoothly to nearly black. Low contrast midtones, richer bronze along left and far right, calm charcoal center. Entire image must be continuous edge-to-edge abstract material, not framed artwork. Wide landscape ratio 3:1. Photorealistic macro material rendering, exceptionally clean and sophisticated.

prompts.title: 스모크 골드
prompts.prompt: Create one premium ABSTRACT BACKGROUND IMAGE, no text, no symbols, no UI, no logos, no recognizable objects. Wide landscape ratio 3:1, designed to be used as a subtle shallow 1920x88 luxury website header strip. Art direction: translucent smoky onyx glass veils and softly diffused champagne light, graceful wide low-amplitude diagonal wisps sweeping horizontally across deep graphite, sparse ultra-fine warm gold filaments suspended in the glass, slight layered refraction. Distinct from metallic fabric and from dotted mesh. Minimal fluid airy composition; no glitter, no dots, no starfield, no busy particles, no ornaments, no sharp polygon clutter, no thick 3D embossing. Keep the center broadly quiet for overlaid navigation. A pale warm gold luminous veil near the upper left and another muted glint near far right; smooth dark graphite below. Low contrast subdued gold and black only, controlled polished photographic atmosphere. Full-bleed seamless-feeling abstract image with no border.
